title: Scout — Mode C: Neighbor-dim HoverStudy extension
purpose: Adds Mode C (neighbor-dim) to Iris's HoverStudy. Static analysis showed Mode A conflates inactivity with rest (same color). Mode C adds a third distinguishable state: inactive neighbors dim (#3a4550) rather than holding rest gray, preserving local specificity while making inactivity legible as a separate category.
